title: Trial channels
description: Process chat from up to {max} unregistered broadcasters, spread across up to three trial sockets. Twitch output stays blocked while they are in a trial.
degraded: Trial state is unavailable. Controls may fail until ingress reconnects.
note: Use the numeric Twitch ID. Turn an individual trial off to pause its chat ingestion; it still counts toward the {max} slots. Registration automatically ends a trial.
